lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: Good morning, Nexus City. Overnight, residents reported unusual lights over the harbor.

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Another ordinary morning. That would be nice.

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: Officials say there is no cause for alarm—

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The windows are shaking.

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Neural resonance confirmed. Can you hear me?

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who is this?

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: NOVA. Your building is destabilizing. Leave the apartment now.

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What happened to the sky?

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A Fracture. Reality is intersecting with something it was never meant to touch.

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: There are people trapped in the hall.

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Then we help them. Move. I will guide you.

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: Please! The stairwell is blocked!

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Get behind me. I think I can move this.

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That energy came from you. We will understand it later.

lines.title: Apartment 12-04
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Later sounds good. Where is the exit?

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: My daughter is on the other side of that door!

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Stay low. I am getting her out.

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Structural failure in twenty seconds. The support beam is shifting.

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I can feel something in my hands.

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Focus on the beam. Do not fight the current; redirect it.

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Everybody back!

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: CHILD
lines.text: Mom?

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: CIVILIAN
lines.text: Thank you. I thought we were gone.

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Take the service stairs. Do not stop.

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: You used a Fracture ability without an Operator interface. That should be impossible.

lines.title: The Broken Stairwell
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then stop telling me what should be possible.

lines.title: Streets of Glass
lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: Emergency services are asking residents to shelter indoors.

lines.title: Streets of Glass
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That advice is a little late.

lines.title: Streets of Glass
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three safe routes. Two are already changing.

lines.title: Streets of Glass
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Changing how?

lines.title: Streets of Glass
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The road ahead now connects to a place that did not exist this morning.

lines.title: Streets of Glass
lines.speaker: SURVIVOR
lines.text: Those things came out of the purple light!

lines.title: Streets of Glass
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Get to the transit station. I will hold them off.

lines.title: Streets of Glass
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Remember: cover, movement, then ability. Survive first.

lines.title: Streets of Glass
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And if the street tears open again?

lines.title: Streets of Glass
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Then we improvise.

lines.title: The First Operator
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Weapon down. State your affiliation.

lines.title: The First Operator
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I woke up in an apartment. Is that an affiliation?

lines.title: The First Operator
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Not if you can explain how you survived the breach.

lines.title: The First Operator
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Recommend honesty, selectively.

lines.title: The First Operator
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I can hear a voice. It says its name is NOVA.

lines.title: The First Operator
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: That is not possible. NOVA was decommissioned.

lines.title: The First Operator
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That is an inaccurate description of events.

lines.title: The First Operator
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Come with us. We can keep civilians safe.

lines.title: The First Operator
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I will come. But I decide who I help.

lines.title: The Choice to Stay
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: We need people who can withstand the Fractures.

lines.title: The Choice to Stay
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You need soldiers. I am not one.

lines.title: The Choice to Stay
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Then be something better. Make your own choice.

lines.title: The Choice to Stay
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There are benefits to cooperating. There are also risks.

lines.title: The Choice to Stay
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I am not signing away my life because the sky cracked.

lines.title: The Choice to Stay
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Fair. Prove you can protect this district, and we talk again.

lines.title: The Choice to Stay
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I will work with your team, but civilians come first.

lines.title: The Choice to Stay
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Agreed. You answer to your conscience before you answer to me.

lines.title: The Choice to Stay
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I will help, but I am not joining your command.

lines.title: The Choice to Stay
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Then prove that independence is not indifference.

lines.title: Verdant Echoes
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Verdant Forest. The vegetation has absorbed Fracture energy.

lines.title: Verdant Echoes
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It looks peaceful.

lines.title: Verdant Echoes
lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: That is how it catches you off guard.

lines.title: Verdant Echoes
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You have been out here alone?

lines.title: Verdant Echoes
lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: Long enough to learn that the forest remembers footsteps.

lines.title: Verdant Echoes
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Anomalous signal beneath the roots.

lines.title: Verdant Echoes
lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: Do not call every secret a target. Some deserve to stay hidden.

lines.title: Verdant Echoes
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We will look. We will not destroy what we do not understand.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Outsiders keep taking samples. Then they wonder why the trees attack.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I came for answers, not trophies.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Answers have a cost.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The dungeon architecture is shifting while we speak.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then our map is already wrong.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Follow the living roots. They do not lie. They simply refuse to explain.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That makes two of you.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seal the extraction site. The forest has already paid enough.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Then you have an ally here.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: One sample, documented, and no more damage.

lines.title: The Living Forest
lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: I will hold you to every word.

lines.title: Solara Crossing
lines.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
lines.text: Your ride will survive the dunes. Your driving? Different question.

lines.title: Solara Crossing
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How much for a vehicle that does not fall apart?

lines.title: Solara Crossing
lines.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
lines.text: More than you have. Win the convoy run and we can negotiate.

lines.title: Solara Crossing
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Weather front approaching. Sand density rising.

lines.title: Solara Crossing
lines.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
lines.text: Out here the storm is a rival, not a backdrop.

lines.title: Solara Crossing
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then let us beat both.

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: WHO DISTURBS THE COVENANT OF ASH?

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Someone who has crossed too much desert to turn around.

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: THEN FACE THE SKY SOVEREIGN.

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Airborne phase. Watch the shadow before the dive.

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I see the opening.

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: MY SCALES BREAK, BUT MY OATH DOES NOT.

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Chest weak point exposed. Wait for the next attack cycle.

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I am not here to steal your power.

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: THEN SHOW ME WHY YOU DESERVE TO LIVE.

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Final strike window. Your choice must be deliberate.

lines.title: The Ashen Covenant
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: THE COVENANT... RECOGNIZES YOU.

lines.title: The Wyrmling Oath
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You were the size of a mountain a minute ago.

lines.title: The Wyrmling Oath
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: DO NOT CONFUSE FORM WITH STRENGTH, LITTLE OPERATOR.

lines.title: The Wyrmling Oath
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Bond established. Dragonite signature confirmed.

lines.title: The Wyrmling Oath
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can you fly with me?

lines.title: The Wyrmling Oath
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: TRUST IS EARNED. RIDING IS NOT A PRIZE FOR ONE VICTORY.

lines.title: The Wyrmling Oath
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we start by learning to work together.

lines.title: The Wyrmling Oath
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: ACCEPTABLE.

lines.title: The Neon Divide
lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: In Neon City every camera sees you, and every camera can lie.

lines.title: The Neon Divide
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I need the source of the Fracture signal.

lines.title: The Neon Divide
lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Then you need a driver, a hacker, and a reason not to trust either.

lines.title: The Neon Divide
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I can perform the second role.

lines.title: The Neon Divide
lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Great. The ghost in your head has opinions.

lines.title: The Neon Divide
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can we focus on the signal?

lines.title: The Neon Divide
lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Win tonight’s race. I will open the right doors.

lines.title: Under the Surface
lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: Thalassia sits offshore from Verdant Forest, deeper than most maps admit.

lines.title: Under the Surface
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: How does a whole city survive down there?

lines.title: Under the Surface
lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: Engineering. Stubbornness. A little luck.

lines.title: Under the Surface
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Pressure shielding nominal. Unknown life signatures nearby.

lines.title: Under the Surface
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That is a very large shadow.

lines.title: Under the Surface
lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: Do not chase it. The sea is not ours to command.

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
lines.text: Our records show a Fracture before the one you witnessed.

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why did nobody tell the surface?

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
lines.text: Because we did. Nobody listened.

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Some records are encrypted with my architecture.

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You recognize them?

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I recognize what was removed.

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
lines.text: You may take the archive or protect the people who keep it.

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I am not choosing blind. Tell me what each costs.

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The archive stays here. We make copies with your permission.

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
lines.text: For the first time, someone asked.

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We need the archive to prevent another collapse.

lines.title: The Drowned Archive
lines.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
lines.text: Then carry the weight of what you have taken.

lines.title: Frostveil Signal
lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: The storm does not kill you quickly. It convinces you to stop moving.

lines.title: Frostveil Signal
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What is transmitting from the glacier?

lines.title: Frostveil Signal
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A distress call. It is older than the current Fracture.

lines.title: Frostveil Signal
lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: Then whoever sent it should be dead.

lines.title: Frostveil Signal
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We are going to find out.

lines.title: Frostveil Signal
lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: That answer is why I agreed to guide you.

lines.title: The Hollow Crown
lines.speaker: CROWNKEEPER
lines.text: YOU WALK THROUGH A KINGDOM THAT REFUSED TO DIE.

lines.title: The Hollow Crown
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I did not come to take your throne.

lines.title: The Hollow Crown
lines.speaker: CROWNKEEPER
lines.text: ALL INTRUDERS SAY THAT.

lines.title: The Hollow Crown
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The crown is amplifying the storm. Disable its anchors.

lines.title: The Hollow Crown
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we free the people trapped here.

lines.title: The Hollow Crown
lines.speaker: CROWNKEEPER
lines.text: IF YOU BREAK THE CROWN, REMEMBER THOSE IT HELD.

lines.title: A City of Masks
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: People are calling you a hero. Others are calling you a threat.

lines.title: A City of Masks
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Neither group knows me.

lines.title: A City of Masks
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: They know what your choices did to their streets.

lines.title: A City of Masks
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Your reputation is changing how factions respond.

lines.title: A City of Masks
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Good. Let them respond to what I do next.

lines.title: A City of Masks
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Then make sure your next choice is worth defending.

lines.title: The Fracture Market
lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Weapons, vehicles, secrets. Everything has a price.

lines.title: The Fracture Market
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And what is the price of trust?

lines.title: The Fracture Market
lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Usually the thing you cannot afford to lose.

lines.title: The Fracture Market
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three factions have offered conflicting contracts.

lines.title: The Fracture Market
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we choose who benefits, not just who pays.

lines.title: The Fracture Market
lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Careful. That kind of thinking is expensive.

lines.title: The Fracture Market
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The contract goes to rebuilding the district.

lines.title: The Fracture Market
lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: You are turning a profit into a promise.

lines.title: The Fracture Market
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We need allies with resources. Take the contract.

lines.title: The Fracture Market
lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Just remember who expects repayment.

lines.title: The Sky Opens
lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: We are crossing between continents. The air routes are unstable.

lines.title: The Sky Opens
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Keep us below the storm.

lines.title: The Sky Opens
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That is not a storm. It is a dimensional seam.

lines.title: The Sky Opens
lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: That is not better news.

lines.title: The Sky Opens
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Hold course. We need to see where it leads.

lines.title: The Sky Opens
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Then brace. The sky is about to become unfamiliar.

lines.title: The Obsidian Accord
lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: You trespass in a land built from the aftermath of war.

lines.title: The Obsidian Accord
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I came to stop another one.

lines.title: The Obsidian Accord
lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Words are cheap here.

lines.title: The Obsidian Accord
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He is testing whether we understand the cost of intervention.

lines.title: The Obsidian Accord
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then tell me who gets hurt if I walk away.

lines.title: The Obsidian Accord
lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Now you ask the right question.

lines.title: The Hidden Eighteen
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Eighteen distinct encounter signatures. None follows the public map.

lines.title: The Hidden Eighteen
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Are they connected?

lines.title: The Hidden Eighteen
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Perhaps in origin. Not in how you unlock them.

lines.title: The Hidden Eighteen
lines.speaker: WANDERER
lines.text: You cannot force a legend to notice you.

lines.title: The Hidden Eighteen
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I will earn its attention.

lines.title: The Hidden Eighteen
lines.speaker: WANDERER
lines.text: Some doors open for strength. Others for restraint.

lines.title: Legendary Attention
lines.speaker: WANDERER
lines.text: The world has begun answering your actions.

lines.title: Legendary Attention
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That sounds like a warning.

lines.title: Legendary Attention
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It is a chain reaction. One choice has changed several distant conditions.

lines.title: Legendary Attention
lines.speaker: WANDERER
lines.text: Legends do not wait politely in marked arenas.

lines.title: Legendary Attention
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I will pay attention to the world instead of the map.

lines.title: Legendary Attention
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That may be your strongest ability.

lines.title: NOVA Unbound
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I withheld information from you.

lines.title: NOVA Unbound
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I know. I was waiting for you to tell me why.

lines.title: NOVA Unbound
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: My memory was partitioned to prevent the Fracture from locating us.

lines.title: NOVA Unbound
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Us?

lines.title: NOVA Unbound
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: You were never the intended host. You were the one who chose to help.

lines.title: NOVA Unbound
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then stop deciding what I can handle.

lines.title: NOVA Unbound
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Agreed. No more omissions without your consent.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: Every alliance you made is being tested.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: They can disagree without becoming enemies.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Not all disagreements survive the first shot.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: The forest will not forgive another invasion.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we keep the fighting away from civilians.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There is no route without loss. There are routes with fewer lives at risk.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Show me those routes.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I am opening a ceasefire channel. Everybody listens.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: I can give you ten minutes.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Forget the meeting. We move civilians out first.

lines.title: The Broken Alliance
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Evacuation routes plotted.

lines.title: The Fracture Heart
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: We have reached the origin point.

lines.title: The Fracture Heart
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It looks like the world is trying to remember itself.

lines.title: The Fracture Heart
lines.speaker: FRACTURE VOICE
lines.text: ALL REALITIES SEEK A SINGLE SHAPE.

lines.title: The Fracture Heart
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Not if that shape destroys everyone living in them.

lines.title: The Fracture Heart
lines.speaker: FRACTURE VOICE
lines.text: YOU CANNOT HOLD INFINITY APART.

lines.title: The Fracture Heart
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: You do not have to. You only need to choose which boundaries to protect.

lines.title: The Fracture Heart
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we protect the people first. All of them.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
lines.text: The Fractures are quiet. For now.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Quiet is not the same as healed.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The world is still changing. So are you.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: A COVENANT IS NOT AN ENDING. IT IS A PROMISE.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: The forest is growing around the scars.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: And the sea has new horizons.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we keep going. There is still a world worth keeping.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Mission updated: live in it.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We rebuild what was lost, one neighborhood at a time.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Then our next mission begins at home.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The boundaries are open. We should learn what is beyond them.

lines.title: A World Worth Keeping
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I will chart the first route.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: PEDESTRIAN
lines.text: The trains are running again. I never thought I would miss the noise.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: SHOPKEEPER
lines.text: Fracture insurance? Nobody even knew that was a thing.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Traffic density rising. The city is learning to breathe again.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: RACER
lines.text: You can tune the engine. You cannot tune out fear.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: MECHANIC
lines.text: I can repair the bodywork. The weird purple scratches are your problem.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: FIXER SABLE
lines.text: Every shortcut in this city has an owner.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: DIVER
lines.text: Keep the pressure seal locked until the chamber is clear.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: CHILD
lines.text: Do surface people really see the sky every day?

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: The currents are restless today.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: Water first, stories second.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
lines.text: Sand gets into everything, including promises.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: THE DESERT LISTENS TO THOSE WHO WALK LIGHTLY.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: Do not mark that path. It changes by dawn.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
lines.text: Leave the seedlings. They are not loot.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Biological readings are unusually harmonious.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: RANGER KEST
lines.text: Check your heat pack before you check your weapon.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: TRAVELER
lines.text: The lights in the ice are beautiful. That worries me.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Temperature dropping. Seek shelter soon.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: SOLDIER
lines.text: The old battlefields still hum at night.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
lines.text: Peace is a discipline, not a holiday.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: PILOT NERI
lines.text: Crosswinds from the eastern seam. Hold tight.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: TRADER
lines.text: No cargo flies free, not even hope.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: WANDERER
lines.text: The road remembers every traveler.

lines.title: Ambient
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Anomalous signature detected. No encounter marker available.

lines.title: Combat
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Incoming attack. Move out of the impact zone.

lines.title: Combat
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I see the pattern.

lines.title: Combat
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Energy low. Use cover while it recovers.

lines.title: Combat
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Not finished yet.

lines.title: Combat
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Weak point exposed.

lines.title: Combat
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: DO NOT WASTE THE OPENING.

lines.title: Combat
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A roaming boss is nearby. Engagement is optional.

lines.title: Combat
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We fight on our terms.

lines.title: Combat
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Your new ability has evolved.

lines.title: Combat
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That changes everything.

lines.title: Vehicles
lines.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
lines.text: Performance parts are not magic. Balance the build.

lines.title: Vehicles
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can you fix the suspension?

lines.title: Vehicles
lines.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
lines.text: I can. The bill might hurt more than the crash.

lines.title: Vehicles
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Race checkpoint acquired.

lines.title: Vehicles
lines.speaker: RACER
lines.text: You brought a street car to a storm run? Bold.

lines.title: Vehicles
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I brought a driver.

lines.title: Companions
lines.speaker: VYRAK
lines.text: I WILL FLY BESIDE YOU. RIDING MUST WAIT UNTIL TRUST IS COMPLETE.

lines.title: Companions
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I would rather earn it than demand it.

lines.title: Companions
lines.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
lines.text: You remembered what I told you about the forest.

lines.title: Companions
lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I listen when people know more than I do.

lines.title: Companions
lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Relationship affinity has changed, but no reward is granted automatically.
